targets.rawSql:
SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(count),0)::bigint AS value
FROM event_rollups_1m
WHERE bucket_ts >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes'
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}');

SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(count),0)::bigint AS value
FROM event_rollups_1m
WHERE bucket_ts >= NOW() - interval '1 hour'
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}');
SELECT MAX("timestamp") AS last_event_ts FROM net_events WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}');
SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM alerts WHERE created_at >= NOW() - interval '1 hour' AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}');

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_ts, '1m'), event_type AS metric, SUM(count)::bigint AS value
FROM event_rollups_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_ts)
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_ts, '1m'), SUM(count)::bigint AS value
FROM event_rollups_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_ts)
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND event_type = 'flow'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_ts, '1m'), SUM(count)::bigint AS value
FROM ssh_fail_rollups_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_ts)
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND action IN ('invalid_password','invalid_user','max_auth_attempts')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, COALESCE(extra->>'action','') AS action, COALESCE(extra->>'user', extra->>'username', '') AS username, COALESCE(extra->>'method','') AS method, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'ssh_auth' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT src_ip, COUNT(*)::bigint AS events FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}') AND src_ip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT dst_port::text AS "port", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count" FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'flow' AND dst_port IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'), severity AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT created_at AS time, rule_id, severity, COALESCE(NULLIF(src_ip,''), NULLIF(details->>'src_ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'source_ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'attacker_ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'remote_ip','')) AS src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(dst_ip,''), NULLIF(details->>'dst_ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'target_ip',''), NULLIF(details->>'target','')) AS dst_ip, COALESCE(dst_port, CASE WHEN NULLIF(details->>'dst_port','') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (details->>'dst_port')::int WHEN NULLIF(details->>'target_port','') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (details->>'target_port')::int ELSE NULL END) AS dst_port, description, details::text AS details_json FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${severity}' = '%' OR severity = '${severity}') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, event_type, src_ip, src_port, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, bytes, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND ('${event_type}' = '%' OR event_type = '${event_type}') ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'lateral_conn' AND COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') = 'attempt' AND dst_port IN (445,3389,5985,5986,135,139) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, agent_id, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, proto, COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') AS lateral_kind, extra::text AS extra_json FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND event_type = 'lateral_conn' AND COALESCE(extra->>'lateral_kind','') = 'attempt' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%');

SELECT NOW() AS time, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'confidence','')::double precision), 0)::bigint AS value FROM net_events WHERE "timestamp" >= NOW() - interval '5 minutes' AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%');

SELECT
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' / ',
      NULLIF(extra->>'attack',''),
      NULLIF(extra->>'vector','')
    ), ''),
    'unknown'
  ) AS attack_kind
FROM net_events
WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(dst_ip,''),
    CASE WHEN dst_port IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ':' || dst_port::text END,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(proto,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE '/' || proto END
  ) AS target
FROM net_events
WHERE ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '1m'),
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' / ',
      NULLIF(extra->>'attack',''),
      NULLIF(extra->>'vector','')
    ), ''),
    'unknown'
  ) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM net_events
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: DoS/DDoS detections per minute by kind

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'confidence' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'confidence','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'confidence')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'tcp_syn_ratio' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'tcp_syn_ratio','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'tcp_syn_ratio')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
) s
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time;

SELECT "time", metric, value FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'pps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'pps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'pps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '10s'), 'bps' AS metric, MAX(NULLIF(extra->>'bps','')::double precision) AS value FROM net_events WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}') AND (event_type = 'dos_attack' OR event_type LIKE 'ddos%') AND NULLIF(extra->>'bps','') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) s ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'http_rps' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'http_rps','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'http_rps')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'tls_handshake_rps' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'tls_handshake_rps','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'tls_handshake_rps')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
) s
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: L7 signals (HTTP RPS / TLS HS RPS max)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'unique_src_ips' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'unique_src_ips','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'unique_src_ips')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeGroup("timestamp",'10s') AS time,
         'src_entropy_norm' AS metric,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(extra->>'src_entropy_norm','') ~ '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
                  THEN (extra->>'src_entropy_norm')::double precision END) AS value
  FROM net_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
    AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
  GROUP BY 1
) s
WHERE value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  "timestamp" AS time,
  agent_id,
  event_type,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(src_ip,''), NULLIF(extra->'top_src'->0->>'ip',''),'multiple') AS src_ip,
  dst_ip,
  dst_port,
  proto,
  COALESCE(extra->>'attack','') AS attack,
  COALESCE(extra->>'vector','') AS vector,
  COALESCE(extra->>'severity','') AS severity,
  COALESCE(extra->>'confidence','') AS confidence,
  COALESCE(extra->>'pps','') AS pps,
  COALESCE(extra->>'bps','') AS bps,
  COALESCE(extra->>'http_rps','') AS http_rps,
  COALESCE(extra->>'tls_handshake_rps','') AS tls_handshake_rps,
  COALESCE(extra->>'tcp_syn_ratio','') AS tcp_syn_ratio,
  COALESCE(extra->>'unique_src_ips','') AS unique_src_ips,
  COALESCE(extra->>'src_entropy_norm','') AS src_entropy_norm,
  extra::text AS extra_json
FROM net_events
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  AND ('${agent}' = '%' OR agent_id = '${agent}')
  AND event_type = 'dos_attack'
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT $__timeGroup(training_finished_at,'5m') AS time,
       AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (training_finished_at - training_started_at)) * 1000.0) AS value
FROM ueba_ml_models
WHERE $__timeFilter(training_finished_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroup(closed_at,'1h') AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN latest_verdict = 'false_positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM ueba_findings
WHERE $__timeFilter(closed_at)
  AND closed_at >= NOW() - interval '7 days'
  AND status IN ('closed', 'suppressed')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroup(last_seen_at,'5m') AS time,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM ueba_findings
WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at)
  AND detector_id = 'peer_group_deviation_v1'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT NOW() AS time,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM ueba_suppressions
WHERE active = TRUE
  AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW());
